Irvine, CA
Operations – IT / Full Time / On-Site
Who are We?
Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications.
Learn more at https://fieldai.com.
About the Job
Field AI is looking for a senior hands-on IT infrastructure engineer to own the systems that keep a robotics engineering organization secure and productive: macOS/Linux endpoints, identity, SaaS access, office/lab networking, and endpoint security. This role is ideal for someone who has operated in fast-moving startup environments, enjoys building durable systems from imperfect starting points, and can move between strategic design and hands-on troubleshooting.




What You'll Get To Do
Endpoint Fleet Management:
Own the full lifecycle of our macOS and Linux endpoint fleet through JumpCloud MDM,  enrollment, configuration, application deployment, patch management, and compliance enforcement. Define and maintain the golden configurations every new device is built from.
Network Operations:
Operate the office and lab network end to end, switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, VLANs, and VPN. Design and configure network infrastructure, perform maintenance and upgrades, and provide deep-dive troubleshooting from layer 1 through layer 7.
Endpoint Security:
Operate CrowdStrike Falcon as our primary EDR — deploy sensors, define prevention and detection policies, tune detection logic to reduce false positives, and lead first response on endpoint security incidents.
Compliance Partnership:
Partner with Security and Legal on SOC 2 and ISO 27001 — translate framework requirements into operational controls, automate evidence collection, and own the IT-side response to audits and quarterly access reviews.
Senior Technical Escalation: Serve as the senior technical resource on the IT team — resolve complex incidents, document resolutions as runbooks, and automate the underlying root cause wherever possible.

What You Have
Senior IT Operations Background:
5+ years of IT engineering experience, including time as a senior individual contributor on a small IT team in a fast-paced startup environment.
Linux & macOS Expertise:
Deep Linux internals knowledge — systemd, kernel and networking subsystems, package management, sso integration, and host-level diagnostics. Equivalent fluency administering macOS at scale.
MDM Expertise:
Production experience administering and scaling a modern MDM platform, ideally JumpCloud — policy authoring, configuration profiles, and rollout strategies across a heterogeneous fleet.
Networking Depth:
Hands-on experience with professional-grade networking equipment such as Sophos, Ubiquiti, or Fortinet — switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and VPN — including packet-level troubleshooting.
Cloud & SaaS Administration:
Hands-on administration of Google Workspace, GitHub, AWS, and Jira Cloud, with strong fundamentals in SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM provisioning, and IAM hygiene.
Endpoint Security:
Working experience with CrowdStrike Falcon or a comparable EDR/XDR platform — sensor deployment, policy configuration, detection tuning, and incident triage.
Compliance Experience:
Practical experience supporting SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 — operationalizing controls, collecting evidence on a recurring cadence, and partnering with auditors.

The Extras That Set You Apart
Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar for IT and identity automation
Experience standing up or maturing a JumpCloud deployment from the ground up
Background supporting robotics, hardware, or lab environments
Prior on-call or incident response experience in a security-conscious environment
Vendor management and procurement experience for IT and security tooling

Compensation and Benefits
Our salary range is generous and we take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary; base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
 
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world's most complex challenges: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ set a new standard in perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, ensuring our approach is explainable and safe for deployment.
You will have the opportunity to work with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. With a decade-long track record of deploying solutions in the field, winning DARPA challenge segments, and bringing expertise from organizations like DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise Self-Driving, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, we are set to achieve our ambitious goals.
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
To tackle such ambitious challenges, we need a team as unique as our vision — innovators who go beyond conventional methods and are eager to tackle tough, uncharted questions. We're seeking individuals who challenge the status quo, dive into uncharted territory, and bring interdisciplinary expertise. Our team requires not only top AI talent but also exceptional software developers, engineers, product designers, field deployment experts, and communicators.
We are headquartered in always-sunny Irvine, Southern California and have US based and global teammates.
Join us, shape the future, and be part of a fun, close-knit team on an exciting journey!
We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

fields.duties:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.
About the Job
The Infrastructure Security Engineer will secure the cloud infrastructure and deployment platforms powering FieldAI’s autonomous robotic systems. You will work closely with engineering teams to design, assess, and improve the security of large-scale distributed systems operating in production environments. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Kubernetes security, cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD systems, software supply chains, identity and access management, and production deployment platforms. Your work will directly impact the reliability, resilience, and security of critical infrastructure supporting real-world autonomous system operations.


What You’ll Get To Do
Design and improve the security architecture of cloud-native infrastructure and Kubernetes environments
Secure CI/CD systems, software supply chains, build pipelines, and deployment workflows
Improve identity, authentication, secrets management, and access control across production systems
Harden Kubernetes clusters, containerized workloads, and runtime environments against modern attack vectors
Conduct threat modeling and security reviews across infrastructure and operational systems
Partner closely with engineering teams to integrate practical security controls into development and operational workflows
Investigate vulnerabilities affecting production infrastructure and help drive remediation and resilience improvements
Help define security standards and best practices for large-scale distributed systems and operational infrastructure

What You Have
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field
5+ years of experience in infrastructure security, cloud security, platform security, SRE, or related domains
Strong software engineering, systems engineering, and networking fundamentals
Experience securing cloud infrastructure and distributed production systems
Experience with Kubernetes, containerized environments, CI/CD systems, and infrastructure automation
Familiarity with identity and access management, secrets management, authentication systems, and secure infrastructure design
Experience with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, vulnerability management, or adversarial security assessments
Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across infrastructure and engineering teams
Practical engineering judgment and the ability to balance security, operational reliability, scalability, and development velocity

The Extras That Set You Apart
Experience securing large-scale distributed or cloud-native systems
Familiarity with software supply chain security, artifact signing, or build provenance systems
Experience with runtime security, Kubernetes security, or production infrastructure hardening
Background in platform engineering, SRE, infrastructure engineering, or cloud-native operations
Experience with offensive security, penetration testing, or adversarial infrastructure assessments
Experience supporting operationally critical or mission-critical production environments

Our salary range is generous and we consider each individual’s background and experience when determining final compensation. Base pay may vary based on role scope, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the Irvine, California market.
 
Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?
In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.
You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.
 
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.
 
Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.
 
We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

fields.duties:
FieldAI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. Our growing R&D team is based in Boston, where we develop risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that tackle the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the potential of embodied intelligence. We take a pragmatic approach that goes beyond off-the-shelf, purely data-driven methods or transformer-only architectures, combining cutting-edge research with real-world deployment. Our solutions are already deployed globally, and we continuously improve model performance through rapid iteration driven by real field use.


FieldAI robots reconstruct and interact with the physical world to unprecedented levels. This asks for an unprecedented user experience. Therefore, we are hiring a 3D/AR/VR Software Engineer in support of our humanoid UI/UX team.
In this role, you will implement, integrate, maintain, and support AR/VR applications that enable supervision, manipulation, and locomotion capabilities for humanoid robots. You will help turn new robotic capabilities into reliable, maintainable, user-facing systems that can be deployed, evaluated, and operated on real robots. Your work will span design, prototyping, UI implementation, and robot integration, user-study-based evaluation. You will draw on your expertise on input and interaction design, rendering, to build innovative 3D interfaces for robotics.


What You Will Get To Do
Set Research Vision and Strategy
Define and execute the robotics AI research roadmap in alignment with FieldAI’s mission and product goals.
Identify emerging research directions, tools, and techniques across robotics, embodied AI, and machine learning.
Establish clear technical goals, milestones, and success metrics tied to real-world robot performance.
Design and Implement Interactive Workflows in AR/VR
Design and implement intuitive 3D workflows for supervising, manipulating, and controlling humanoid robots in AR/VR.
Build interaction techniques for spatial input, visualization, teleoperation, task specification, and robot feedback.
Prototype, evaluate, and iterate on new interaction concepts through user studies and deployment on real robotic systems.
Integrate the UI with the Robot
Integrate AR/VR applications with robot perception, planning, manipulation, locomotion, and control systems.
Build robust interfaces for exchanging commands, state, sensor data, and 3D scene representations between robots and user-facing applications.
Debug and optimize end-to-end system behavior across headsets, networks, compute infrastructure, and robotic hardware.
Deploy and Support Systems in the Real World
Turn research prototypes into reliable, maintainable applications that can be deployed and operated on real robots.
Develop tooling, testing, monitoring, and deployment workflows that support repeatable operation across robots and environments.
Diagnose failures in the field and continuously improve system performance, reliability, usability, and robustness.
Collaborate Across Disciplines
Work closely with researchers and engineers across perception, planning, control, manipulation, and hardware.
Translate new robotic capabilities into user-facing workflows and identify interface requirements that inform system design.
Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, experimentation, and the development of software infrastructure.

Experience working with databases such as MongoDB, Redis, or similar

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across the stack

Experience building and scaling production applications used by external customers

You’ll tackle hard problems like network handoffs, intermittent connectivity, and maintaining real-time performance under mobility, interference, and degraded conditions. Build low-latency, bidirectional audio/video streaming systems for telepresence and teleoperation
Design and optimize real-time communication over private 5G and heterogeneous networks
Monitor and improve network performance (latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput) in dynamic environments
Implement QoS strategies, congestion control, and adaptive streaming for reliable operation
Develop, test, and deploy communication systems directly on robotic platforms
Ensure robust performance under mobility, degraded connectivity, and real-world conditions

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
Strong experience building real-time or near real-time communication systems (e.g., TCP/UDP, RTP/RTCP, WebRTC)
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, especially in wireless and cellular contexts (latency, jitter, handoffs, bandwidth constraints)
Experience working with Linux networking and debugging tools (e.g., tcpdump, iperf, ss, iw)
Familiarity with distributed systems and device-to-cloud communication architectures
Experience developing and validating systems on physical hardware, not just simulations
Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2 or similar frameworks for distributed robotic systems

What Will Set You Apart
Experience deploying systems over cellular networks (LTE/5G), including private 5G setups
Background in telepresence, teleoperation, or real-time audio/video streaming systems
Deep understanding of adaptive bitrate, congestion control, QoS, and fault-tolerant networking
Experience with media and streaming frameworks (e.g., WebRTC, GStreamer, RTP pipelines)
Familiarity with mesh networking or device-to-device communication systems
Experience designing systems that gracefully handle intermittent connectivity and mobility
Strong ownership mindset, from system design through real-world deployment and iteration

A Figure é uma empresa de robótica e IA que desenvolve robôs humanoides autônomos de uso geral. O objetivo da empresa é lançar robôs humanoides com inteligência de nível humano. Seus robôs são projetados para executar uma grande variedade de tarefas nos mercados residencial e comercial. A Figure tem sede em San Jose, Califórnia, e está estabelecendo sua primeira unidade de operações de dados no Brasil.
Como
IT Operations Specialist
, você é o dono da TI da nossa unidade de São Paulo: suporte ao usuário, frota de dispositivos e rede do escritório, tudo construído do zero e operado com autonomia, em coordenação com o time de TI da Figure nos EUA. Você será uma das primeiras contratações no Brasil.
Esta é uma posição em tempo integral e presencial, na nossa unidade de São Paulo.
Responsabilidades
Conduzir o suporte ao usuário: onboarding e offboarding (entrada e saída de colaboradores), contas, troubleshooting (diagnóstico e resolução de problemas) e periféricos.
Gerenciar uma frota de dispositivos Apple: provisionamento, inscrição no MDM (gerenciamento de dispositivos), atualizações, ciclo de vida e registros de ativos.
Administrar contas, grupos e acessos do Google Workspace em coordenação com o time de TI da matriz (HQ).
Gerenciar a rede e a conectividade do escritório (Wi-Fi, switches, relacionamento e escalações com provedores de internet) com apoio de fornecedores.
Montar salas de reunião, impressoras e equipamentos compartilhados de uma unidade nova.
Planejar para a escala: compras, capacidade e modelo de suporte conforme o time cresce.
Requisitos
4-8 anos em suporte ou operações de TI, incluindo experiência como principal ou único responsável pela TI de uma unidade ou escritório.
Experiência prática com macOS e gestão de dispositivos Apple (ferramentas de MDM como Jamf, Kandji ou Mosyle).
Experiência administrando Google Workspace.
Conhecimento sólido de redes de escritório (Wi-Fi, DHCP, VLANs e gestão de fornecedores).
Inglês em nível profissional (trabalho diário com um time de TI nos EUA).
Diferenciais
Experiência abrindo um novo escritório ou escalando a TI em uma empresa de rápido crescimento.
Scripts ou automação básica para configuração de dispositivos.
Remuneração
Salário base:
R$ 9.000 a R$ 13.000 por mês
Benefícios:
vale-transporte, vale-refeição e plano de saúde
